resolution: Email29 source template: source-seeded App10 Reply reuses only exact current reader data and retains fresh authority, custody and source disclosure checks. Host136 remains the minimum compatible wire contract; rollout remains gated on the coordinated Host137 acceptance step. Both Kit42 consumers retain exact published Host134 release-flow bytes and provenance. The detached Email29 release manifest resolves final source and artifacts without self-reference.

email.kit_compatibility: Host136 must be deployed before this App: source-seeded compose/reply opening, scoped read recovery, form preflight and hidden-image presentation require its generic contracts. Both consumers retain exact Host134 Kit alpha.42 with app-owned domain modules. Runtime27 retains the old source_refs creation path and exact first-save revalidation and preserves authority denials, finite expiry, cancellation and ordinary client limits.

supported_environment.runtime_platform: POSIX with durable private storage and HTTPS

limitations: Operator-managed developer preview, not production Gmail/Outlook parity.
Refresh can take tens of seconds; repeated latency campaigns are outside release acceptance.
OAuth configuration, purpose-specific Host gates/keys, reviewed grants and durable Runtime custody are required.
Resource publication for Task/Knowledge integration needs separate reviewed finite or explicitly Host-issued until_revoked consent; technical renewal alone does not grant it.
